title: aster microcephalus
intro: Aster microcephalus, commonly known as the Small-headed Aster, is a flowering plant species in the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Aster microcephalus include reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and exhibiting antioxidant activity, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids. These bioactive compounds contribute to the plant's potential in treating conditions such as fever, digestive issues, and respiratory problems.
